name: adapt_cart_limit_rust_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: max_items.txt (a spec file the cart limit must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old limit into src/lib.rs

max_items.txt has changed. Make sure can_add() enforces the CURRENT limit in the file.
